entities.name: Arkin Labs
entities.one_liner: Chennai UAV avionics maker — AeroMind flight controllers, Navroc GNSS, power modules. Claims Indian design and manufacture; chip-level sourcing undisclosed.

entities.name: YARI Robotics
entities.one_liner: Coimbatore drone avionics firm — V6X flight controller (claimed designed and built in India), GNSS and power modules, ESCs, flight-data platform.

entities.name: Ascend Powerpacks
entities.one_liner: Hyderabad drone battery-pack maker — Li-ion, Li-HV and semi-solid-state packs with in-house BMS. Cell origin undisclosed.

entities.name: Millennium Semiconductors India
entities.one_liner: Indian component distributor with a drone portfolio of foreign-brand processors, sensors, GNSS, MOSFETs and BMS — a component-intelligence node, not an OEM.

entities.name: Nicomatic India
entities.one_liner: Bengaluru subsidiary of France's Nicomatic — MIL-standard connectors and cable assemblies; states Indian manufacturing since 2022.

entities.name: TE Connectivity
entities.one_liner: Global interconnect multinational with a dedicated UAV connector portfolio; benchmark foreign supplier. Indian manufacturing of the UAV line not established.

entities.name: Rangsons Aerospace
entities.one_liner: Indian defence electronics house — EW suites, RWR, jamming; reported SATCOM-on-the-move and secure datalinks. UAV-specific products not yet evidenced.

entities.name: Drogo Aerospace
entities.one_liner: Hyderabad defence UAV maker. Reported first batch of 41 JK 250e drones to the Army (Jun 2026, ₹72 cr); loitering-munition MoU with Munitions India.

entities.name: VU Dynamics
entities.one_liner: IIT Kanpur-incubated defence UAV developer — long-endurance platforms, launchers, simulators; PATH Group partnership (reported as takeover).

entities.name: Zerosum Technologies
entities.one_liner: Indian UAV subsystem integrator — propulsion, autopilots, GNSS-denied navigation, RF, recovery. Partner vs in-house technology unmapped.

entities.name: WARG Robotics
entities.one_liner: Bengaluru firm building an encrypted low-latency digital UAV link, autonomous supervision and FPV air/ground platforms. Proprietary tech claimed.
